specGaps.summary: The public contract does not publish ErrorReport download bytes, media type, or response shape.
The Manager adds no Bundle query route, so refreshed historical Bundle UI state has no public read seam.
Only a claimed-worker barrier is public; effect-complete and before-commit checkpoints are not published.
